headline: America loses President Kennedy
post_facts: Shot in Dealey Plaza, Dallas, about 12:30 p.m.
Lyndon Johnson took the oath aboard Air Force One

scenes.text: [solemnly] On this day, in nineteen sixty-three... America lost its president.

scenes.label: Dallas Love Field
scenes.caption: The Kennedys arrive that morning
scenes.title: A visit to Dallas
scenes.text: [softly] John and Jacqueline Kennedy rode through Dallas, past cheering crowds.

scenes.label: Downtown Dallas
scenes.caption: The presidential motorcade
scenes.title: Shots in Dealey Plaza
scenes.text: [gravely] At about twelve thirty, shots were fired in Dealey Plaza.

scenes.label: years old, the 35th president
scenes.text: [solemnly] The forty-six-year-old president died within the hour.

scenes.label: Aboard Air Force One
scenes.caption: Photo by Cecil Stoughton
scenes.title: A new president sworn in
scenes.text: [softly] That afternoon, aboard Air Force One, Lyndon Johnson took the oath, with Jacqueline Kennedy at his side.

scenes.title: A nation in mourning
scenes.text: [solemnly] A grieving nation stopped... and mourned together.
